title: SKU & pricing cutover: cross-functional comms, release notes, and sales enablement sequencing
creator: Nina Chen
description: Coordinate SKU and quota cutover across billing, console, docs, and GTM. This ticket sequences the comms milestones, final release notes text, customer-facing help updates, sales enablement assets, and post-cutover monitoring. Scope covers: final SKU naming, limits and quota translations, example entitlement mappings, billing migration notes, console text changes, and a public-facing release notes entry. Goal is a single source of truth for all cross-team artifacts and a dry-run process to validate cutover steps before billing window close.
acceptance_criteria: Final SKU table published in Confluence and linked from billing portal
Release notes drafted, approved by Legal, and scheduled in product blog and in-app banner
Sales enablement deck and FAQ completed and shared with GTM by 2026-03-20
Console labels and entitlement translations merged into main and validated in staging
Billing cutover runbook reviewed and signed off by Finance and SRE
